policies.title: Nauruan ordinary passports: advance Schengen visa for Vatican access via Italy
policies.summary: A Nauruan ordinary-passport visitor needs the advance Italian or Schengen visa required for the unavoidable access route through Italy to Vatican City.
conditions: Vatican City is an enclave with an open Italian and Schengen border; this classifies the unavoidable access leg and does not call the instrument a Vatican visa.

Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 makes Nauru's Annex II exemption conditional on a visa-waiver agreement entering into force. The Council's register, last reviewed 3 March 2026, says the regime applies only after conclusion of that agreement.
Italy's current exemption page incorrectly lists Nauru despite the controlling EU condition. The higher-ranking Regulation and the Council's current agreement register control this adjudication.

Apply for the short-stay Schengen visa before travel through the competent Italian or other Schengen representation. Validity, supporting documents, purpose, admission and Holy See public-access controls remain separate.

application.label: Italian MFA Visa for Italy portal
steps: Use the official Visa for Italy portal to identify the short-stay visa and competent representation for the Italian access leg.
Submit the required application and supporting documents to the competent diplomatic or consular representation before travel.
Carry the issued visa and supporting entry documents; the visa does not guarantee admission or access to controlled Vatican areas.

policies.title: Barbadian ordinary passports: Russian unified eVisa
policies.summary: Barbadian ordinary-passport visitors are legally eligible for Russia's single-entry unified electronic visa for qualifying short visits.
conditions: Government Order 3583-r added Barbados to the unified-eVisa nationality list. The current MFA entry table and current MFA country list both repeat the eVisa route.
The visa is single-entry, valid 120 days from issue and permits no more than 30 days from entry for the listed visitor purposes through approved border checkpoints.
Apply between 86 and 4 days before entry using a machine-readable national passport valid at least six months from application; insurance, fee and final admission requirements remain applicable.

Operational warning: on 26 August 2026 the live application's embedded nationality selector omitted Barbados despite the controlling order and two MFA schedules. Confirm that the portal accepts Barbados before making non-refundable arrangements.

application.label: Russian MFA unified eVisa application
application.processingTime: The MFA states that processing takes no more than 4 calendar days after submission.
steps: Confirm that Barbados is available in the current application interface, then create an account on the official MFA service.
Submit the application, passport data, photograph and fee between 86 and 4 days before planned entry.
Save the positive eVisa notification and present it to the carrier and border officer at an approved crossing point.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: arrival treatment is limited to Portugal permanent residents
conflicts.explanation: Niue's live schedule names Portugal only for permanent residents and requires every other traveller to apply before travel. A passport-only result cannot represent both cohorts.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: normal entry depends on Hong Kong residence documents while the HKSAR passport rule is transit-only
conflicts.explanation: Macao gives the normal exemption and one-year stay to Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card or Re-entry Permit holders; the HKSAR passport alone has a conditional seven-day transit rule.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: normal mainland entry uses an endorsed exit permit while the PRC passport rule is transit-only
conflicts.explanation: Macao gives normal mainland treatment through a Two-way Exit Permit with Macao endorsement; a PRC passport alone is listed only for conditional seven-day transit.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: the Italian access-leg waiver excludes a still-issued Serbian passport cohort
conflicts.explanation: Italy's live schedule limits Serbia to biometric passports and excludes Coordination Directorate passports, which Serbia confirms remain a current issuance channel. One passport-wide result is overbroad.
